threat_event: Skimming script on group venue checkout pages through one of 23 tenant-added tags
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Live Venues marketing adds tags through the tag manager; tags not inventoried or monitored
affected_asset_or_process: TVOP Live Venues tenant (about 14 million orders a year)
likelihood_basis: EV-049 (23 tags with no approval record); EV-065 (content security policy allows the tag manager domain)
treatment_plan: Remove all tenant tags from checkout; approved tag list for event pages only
owner: Live Venues security and compliance lead

threat_event: POS malware captures card data at the 8 acquired theaters
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 410 non-P2PE terminals on flat networks; no EDR or SIEM
affected_asset_or_process: Acquired theater POS and box offices
likelihood_basis: EV-050 (about 410 non-P2PE terminals on flat networks); EV-013 (no EDR at the theaters)
treatment_plan: Interim segmentation and EDR; validated P2PE devices; migration to the TVOP

threat_event: Dynamic pricing sets accessible seats above other seats in the section or above an artist cap
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Accessible price levels in auto-apply at 27 venues; caps not entered for every event
likelihood_basis: EV-072 (accessible levels in auto-apply at 27 venues; caps not entered for every event)
existing_controls: Floors and ceilings at some venues
treatment_plan: Remove accessible levels from auto-apply; enter caps for every event (P10)

threat_event: Venue websites and emails advertise ticket prices without mandatory fees
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Calendar listings and emails show base prices
likelihood_basis: EV-092 (base prices on venue websites and in emails)
treatment_plan: Total price in all displays; pre-publication check

threat_event: The acquired theaters' legacy ticketing vendor fails or is breached with no group oversight
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No contract security terms or AOC review; not in the provider list
likelihood_basis: EV-050 (vendor contracts assigned with no security terms or AOC review); EV-044 (seller's vendor not on the provider list)
treatment_plan: Obtain AOC; incident terms; accelerate migration

threat_event: Ransomware halts box office, POS, and scanners at venues on an event day
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Venue servers for CCTV and production on shared venue infrastructure
likelihood_basis: EV-046 (CCTV and production on venue infrastructure); EV-081 (Live Venues risk interviews)
existing_controls: EDR; segmented venue networks; P2PE devices
treatment_plan: Venue event-day downtime procedures tested each season

threat_event: A stale seasonal box office account is used to issue refunds or comps
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 180 seasonal accounts active after the season
likelihood_basis: EV-007 (seasonal accounts exempt from inactivity disabling); EV-C-AC2 (180 accounts enabled after the season, tested 2026-07-06)
treatment_plan: Season-end expiry in identity governance
owner: Live Venues security and compliance lead

threat_event: An attacker uses an integrator's persistent tunnel to reach CCTV and door access systems
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Persistent remote tunnels at 6 venues
likelihood_basis: EV-047 (persistent integrator tunnels at 6 venues)
existing_controls: CCTV segments separate from box office
treatment_plan: On-request access through group PAM

threat_event: A skimming overlay is placed on a P2PE device at a stand
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Event-day contractor staff; busy stands
likelihood_basis: EV-045 (inspections before each event day; quarterly reconciliation); EV-002 (contractor event staff)
treatment_plan: Inspection training for contractor leads

threat_event: Bots and linked accounts buy beyond the posted limit at high-demand on-sales
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Limits enforced per account only
likelihood_basis: EV-072 (limits enforced per account); EV-093 (posted limit of 8)
treatment_plan: Linked-account checks; 12-month evidence retention (P10)

threat_event: Face templates from the express entry pilot are mishandled
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No privacy review; vendor retention unclear
likelihood_basis: EV-084 (no privacy review; contract states no retention period)
regulatory_driver: N72-R04 (Fla. Stat. 501.171 worked example); N51-R01 (15 U.S.C. 45(a))
treatment_plan: Privacy review and vendor terms before any expansion (P10)
owner: Live Venues security and compliance lead

threat_event: Scanner offline mode fails at doors during a platform or WAN outage
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Offline mode tested at 4 of 30 venues
likelihood_basis: EV-048 (offline mode tested at 4 of 30 venues; 2025 failure)
treatment_plan: Offline mode test at every venue each season

threat_event: Radios, CCTV, or emergency communications fail on an event day
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single CCTV recorder per venue at 11 venues
likelihood_basis: EV-046 (single CCTV recorder at 11 venues)
treatment_plan: Redundant recorders at the 11 venues

threat_event: A phished venue staff member's session is used to change tenant settings
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Adversary-in-the-middle phishing can steal sessions
likelihood_basis: EV-006 (number-matching MFA for venue staff); EV-081 (Live Venues risk interviews)
treatment_plan: Phishing-resistant MFA for tenant administrators
owner: Live Venues security and compliance lead

threat_event: Touring crew equipment infects the production network
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Crews connect to production segments
likelihood_basis: EV-046 (touring crews connect to production segments)
existing_controls: Production segments separate from business segments
treatment_plan: Visitor port rules and inspection

threat_event: A rogue access point bridges guest Wi-Fi and staff networks
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Large public spaces
likelihood_basis: EV-046 (quarterly rogue access point scans)
treatment_plan: Continuous wireless monitoring at arenas

threat_event: Show settlement figures are altered to divert promoter payments
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Settlement sheets emailed for approval
likelihood_basis: EV-052 (settlement sheets emailed for approval; dual payment approval)
treatment_plan: Call-back verification for payment changes

threat_event: Venue marketing staff export patron lists to agencies without contracts
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Exports allowed for the marketing role
likelihood_basis: EV-052 (marketing role can export patron lists)
treatment_plan: Export approval workflow; agency data terms

threat_event: A hurricane closes Florida venues during the season
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Several venues in Florida
likelihood_basis: EV-042 (venues in Florida); EV-081 (Live Venues risk interviews)
treatment_plan: Hurricane playbooks per venue

threat_event: Box office staff issue fraudulent refunds
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Refund rights at the box office

treatment_plan: Supervisor approval over a set amount

threat_event: Screenshotted barcodes cause duplicate entry disputes

threat_event: Contractor event staff mishandle card devices or patron data

threat_event: CCTV video is disclosed or kept longer than needed

threat_event: Migration of the acquired theaters slips past 2027-03-31

threat_event: Staff misconfigure an on-sale (wrong price levels or holds)
